root.label: Global Hawk drone crashes off Tottori

events.label: Global Hawk drone crashes off Tottori

slots.name: wreckage depth
slots.sentence: The Japan Air Self-Defense Force said it has determined that the drone had crashed and later spotted what appeared to be the fuselage on the seabed about 200-300 meters (650-980 feet) deep.

slots.name: communication delay
slots.sentence: Japanese officials have said the drone had trouble connecting with a communication device about 90 minutes after taking off from the Misawa Air Base, where it was based.

slots.name: last seen distance
slots.sentence: Three minutes later, it disappeared from the radar and was last seen 50 kilometers (31 miles) off the coast of Tottori.

slots.name: drone price
slots.sentence: The loss of the drone with a price tag of about 17 billion yen ($107 million)

slots.name: disappearance date
slots.sentence: The uncrewed RQ-4B aircraft, known as Global Hawk, went missing off the northern coast of Tottori prefecture in northwestern Japan in mid-September.

slots.name: investigation status
slots.sentence: There has been no indication of foul play and officials said the cause of the crash was under investigation.
